BiblicalUsage: The LORD opened Leah's womb and shut Rachel's, and then He remembered Rachel and opened her womb too. Every firstborn that openeth the womb is God's, sanctified to Him. Before Jeremiah was formed in the belly, God knew him, and the psalmist says he was cast upon the LORD from the womb.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the womb is holy ground, because God is there before anyone else. He opens and shuts it as He wills, He knows the child before the child knows anything, and no life is an accident to Him. That is why I hold every unborn child as known by God.
